resources.string: Use Astral’s music account setup and choose from your available sources.
Play through a separate librespot device
Start librespot on a device, then pair it with your Spotify account. Once you’re signed in to Spotify in Astral, choose the receiver in Listen On.
No browser could open the setup page.
To use librespot in Square, open its engine settings and pair the receiver. Then select it in Listen on.
